sections.description:
BALOCHISTAN PLANNING AND DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT (BPS-16 AND ABOVE)
SERVICE RULES, 1984
BALOCHISTAN PLANNING AND DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT (BPS-16 AND ABOVE) SERVICE
RULES, 1984
(Amendment of Appendix)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 25th October, 2012]
No.SO(R-II)(18)1/2012-S&GAD/2322-75,
dated 25-10-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 25 of the
Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (IX of 1974), the Government of
Balochistan is pleased to make the following amendment in the Balochistan
Planning and Development Department (BPS-16 and above) Service Rules, 1984,
namely:--
In the
aforesaid rules, in the appendix, at serial No.
2, in column 4, for the existing entries the following shall be
substituted:--
"By
promotion from amongst he members of the Service holding the post of Chief of
Section (BPS-19) and Director Development (P&D) (BPS-19) having seventeen
(17) years, service in BPS-17 and above, and have successfully completed Senior
Management Course, on seniority cum fitness basis.
For the
purpose a combined seniority list of Chief of Section and Director Development,
Planning and Development Department from the date of their regular appointment
to that cadre, post and grade shall be maintained.".
